title: 第10章 你算什么东西第11章 六阳融雪丹
lines: “脑子有坑？”
江玄眼神冰冷的望着那少年，他在这里吃饭，就得罪了这个素未谋面的少年？
看到那洒落一地的灵兽肉，江玄只觉得一脸的肉疼。
“可惜了这些灵兽肉！都浪费了！”
闻言，在场的众人一阵无言，这家伙究竟知不知道自己打了什么人，那可是让天水郡天骄一个个闻风散胆的狠人，但这家伙可好，打了人关心却是他那洒落一地的灵兽肉。
这“噗！”
那秦狩被江玄一拳轰退，此时他只感觉到脸上一阵火辣辣的疼，他面色阴沉，随后看向了与他一同进来的那位老者，开口说道：“古执事，这事你看怎么办？”
“是天水楼阁的古执事！”
“据说他和秦家一直关系很好。”
在场的许多人一下子便是认出了眼前的那名老者，纷纷开口。
那被成为古执事的老者则是皱了皱眉，有些为难，按理来说来者皆是客，他并不应该偏袒任何一方。
然而，那秦狩的身份却摆在那，是天水郡的天才，更是秦家主最疼爱的小儿子。
相反，那刚刚击败了秦狩的小子却是面生的很，想来也不是什么大家族中走出的天骄。
当下，古执事心中便有了决断，对着江玄说道。
“小子，你可知道在我天水楼阁中是不允许出手伤人的，否则都要承担沉重的代价，老夫念你是初犯，所以只要你能够自断双臂，并向秦公子道歉，此事便就此揭过。”
那古执事说这话时，语气平淡没有丝毫波澜，仿佛在他看来这已经是给江玄莫大的恩赐般。
闻言，众人一阵摇头，这古执事果然是偏向这秦狩，不过这也自然，谁叫这秦狩背后有秦家这头猛虎作为他的靠山。
在江玄身旁的云曦美眸含怒，就打算为江玄出头，然而就在这时“老家伙，想要我道歉，你算什么东西？”
静！场上再度变得寂静了下来。
所有的人心脏猛的一跳，他是疯了吗？
江玄目光微冷，谁是谁非在场的众人一个个都看得十分清楚，然而即便如此，这老家伙依旧要惩罚自己，那么他自然也不会给对方好脸色看。
“这家伙怎么敢对古执事这般讲话，这一次怕是谁都救不了他啦！”
果然，当江玄话音落下的那一刻，他们便能够见到那原本笑容满面的古执事面色瞬间阴沉了下来，体内一道雷鸣般的声响刹那间传了出来。
周围不乏一些看好戏的人，他们一脸戏谑的望着场中的变化，他们都知道江玄完了！“怎么回事？”
不过就在这个时候，一道冰冷的喝声，让原本火冒三丈的古执事清醒了几分，见到来人，他连忙躬身行礼。
“掌柜的。”
至于其他人，也都是连忙行礼，在这天水郡中，天水楼阁的掌柜即便是那些大家族的家主也不敢轻易得罪，只因为他身后站着的是百宝堂这尊庞然大物。
不过在这些人中，却不包括江玄。
content_en:
"Is there something wrong with your brain?"
Jiang Xuan looked at the young man with cold eyes. Did he offend this young man he had never met before by eating here?
Seeing the spirit beast meat scattered on the floor, Jiang Xuan felt pain in his face.
"It's a pity that these spiritual beast meats are all wasted!"
Hearing this, everyone present was speechless for a while. Did this guy know who he was beating? He was a ruthless person who made all Tianshui County's geniuses feel frightened. But this guy was so good. He beat people and paid attention to them, but it was his spiritual beast meat that was scattered all over the floor.
This "poof!"
Qin Shou was knocked back by Jiang Xuan's punch. At this time, he only felt a burning pain on his face. His face was gloomy. Then he looked at the old man who came in with him and said, "Deacon Gu, what do you think we should do about this?"
"It's the ancient deacon of Tianshui Pavilion!"
"It is said that he has always had a good relationship with the Qin family."
Many people present immediately recognized the old man in front of them and spoke one after another.
The old man who was called the ancient deacon frowned and was a little embarrassed. Logically speaking, everyone who came was a guest, and he should not take sides.
However, Qin Shou's identity is there. He is the genius of Tianshui County, and he is the most beloved son of the Qin family.
On the contrary, the boy who had just defeated Qin Shou looked very cool, and he was not a genius from a big family.
At that moment, Deacon Gu made a decision in his heart and said to Jiang Xuan.
"Boy, do you know that you are not allowed to hurt others in my Tianshui Pavilion, otherwise you will have to bear a heavy price. I think you are a first offender, so as long as you can cut off your arms and apologize to Mr. Qin, the matter will be over."
When Deacon Gu said this, his tone was calm and without any emotion, as if in his opinion this was already a great gift to Jiang Xuan.
Hearing this, everyone shook their heads for a while. The ancient deacon was indeed biased towards Qin Shou, but this was natural, because Qin Shou had the fierce tiger of the Qin family as his backer.
Yun Xi's beautiful eyes next to Jiang Xuan were filled with anger, and she planned to stand up for Jiang Xuan, but at this moment, "Old guy, if you want me to apologize, who do you think you are?"
Quiet! The place became silent again.
Everyone's heart skipped a beat. Is he crazy?
Jiang Xuan's eyes were slightly cold. Everyone present could see clearly who was who and who was wrong. However, even so, the old guy still wanted to punish himself, so naturally he would not give the other party a good look.
"How dare this guy speak to Deacon Gu like this? No one can save him this time!"
Sure enough, the moment Jiang Xuan finished speaking, they could see that the smiling face of Deacon Gu suddenly turned gloomy, and a thunderous sound came out from within his body.
There were many people watching the show around. They looked at the changes in the scene with a joking expression. They all knew that Jiang Xuan was finished! "What's going on?"
But at this moment, a cold shout made the originally furious Deacon Gu wake up a little. When he saw the person coming, he quickly bowed and saluted.
"The shopkeeper's."
As for the others, they all saluted hurriedly. In this Tianshui County, the shopkeeper of Tianshui Pavilion, even the heads of the big families, did not dare to offend easily, just because the person standing behind him was the giant of Baibao Hall.
However, among these people, Jiang Xuan was not included.
